items.name: ash_embers
items.summary: A field of sparks, glowing cinders and tumbling ash rising off an unseen fire, with a dithered heat band along the bottom.

items.name: aura
items.summary: A flickering aura of power around a standing character: flame tongues behind, sparks rising in front.

items.name: black_hole
items.summary: A black hole forms, swirls with a lensed glowing disk, swallows streaks and ground slabs, then implodes and bursts.

items.name: block_shatter
items.summary: A faceted ice block rises, is struck from the left, cracks race over it, it flashes white and bursts into shards and chunks that settle.

items.name: chain_bolt
items.summary: Lightning leaping from the hand along the ground through hop points, arcing over each, with sparks and scorch at every hop.

items.name: crystal_bloom
items.summary: A cluster of seven faceted crystals pops up big-first, shimmers with a sweeping glint, then slumps and melts away dripping.

items.name: energy_orb
items.summary: A crackling ball of energy (projectile head or charge-up) with orbiting sparks.

items.name: explosion
items.summary: Fireball explosion: flash, a billowing fire mass that burns out, a shockwave ring, debris.

items.name: firefly_meadow
items.summary: Fireflies over swaying grass: close ones fly loops with flapping wings and pulsing tails, far ones blink between the blades.

items.name: firelight
items.summary: Warm, flickering firelight from below, as from a campfire at the subject's feet; the far side sinks into the dark.

items.name: flame
items.summary: A burning flame (campfire, torch, brazier).

items.name: glint_scatter
items.summary: Four small glints catching one after another, each with mini glints, specks and tiny stars.

items.name: ground_blast
items.summary: A big ground explosion: a flash, a fiery core under a shockwave ring, rocks flung out, then dark smoke columns that rise and drift away.

items.name: ground_sigil
items.summary: Summoning circle on the ground (low top-down), turning, with light rising out of it.

items.name: heal_pillar
items.summary: A soft column of healing light with a ground ring and rising sparkles.

items.name: hex_shield
items.summary: A see-through dome of hexagon cells over the sprite: the far side behind it, the near side see-through in front, turning slowly, a pulse of light running down from the top each loop.

items.name: ice_spike_line
items.summary: Six faceted ice spikes erupt one after another along the ground, each taller than the last, stand, flash white and shatter in turn: a marching frost attack.

items.name: impact_burst
items.summary: A hit spark: white flash, rays and a ring punching outward, sparks.

items.name: light_sweep
items.summary: A light circling the subject: sunlight moving across a rock, a planet turning, an asteroid tumbling past a star.

items.name: lightning_strike
items.summary: A bolt strikes down from above, flashes, hits the ground with a shockwave and sparks.

items.name: magic_circle
items.summary: Front-facing arcane circle: rings, a hexagram and a rune band that turn slowly, twinkling motes.

items.name: night_fog
items.summary: Three ground-fog banks drifting right at 15/20/24 px/s in flat posterised tones with thin lit crests, nearest bank in front of the feet.

items.name: plasma_beam
items.summary: A thick sustained beam fired from the hand: a wobbling banded body with racing pulses and a helix, an impact crown spraying plasma and smoke onto molten ground, tapering to a 1 px line.

items.name: plasma_globe
items.summary: A hovering see-through glass globe: dithered sphere, six crackling filaments, a pulsing core, orbiting motes and a zap to the ground every ~1.3 s.

items.name: portal
items.summary: An upright swirling portal: churning core, glowing rim, orbiting motes.

items.name: rim_glow
items.summary: A pulsing rim of light around the subject's outline, as if something bright stands right behind it (a portal, a halo, an explosion).

items.name: shield_bubble
items.summary: A protective bubble: shimmering rim, glints running round it.

items.name: shockwave
items.summary: A stomp or landing: a ring of force racing out along the ground, kicking up dust.

items.name: slam_pillar
items.summary: A 3.4 s gold column slams down after a guide line and gathering sparks: hard bands, fibres, pulses, rising halos, two ground rings, stars and feathers, thinning to a thread.

items.name: slant_rain
items.summary: Wind-slanted rain in three depths: far drops end mid-air, mid and near drops splash crowns and droplets, dithered mist along the ground.

items.name: slash_arc
items.summary: A sword slash: a crescent that sweeps open, then fades, with a few glints.

items.name: smg_burst
items.summary: Rapid fire: 9 shots, each a one-frame jagged star (a long jet and petals, white-hot core, orange rim; alternate shots smaller and redder), sparks per shot, brass casings tumbling back onto the floor and smoke gathering over the muzzle.

items.name: smoke_puff
items.summary: A puff of smoke that billows up and thins away.

items.name: snow_drift
items.summary: Slow three-depth snow drifting right; 2×2 flakes and turning crystals land and lie on a wavy drift.

items.name: spark_hit
items.summary: A bullet-style hit from the left: a spiky white-hot star and a ring snap out, sparks spray back and fall, chips and shards drop.

items.name: toxic_cloud
items.summary: A flask smashes and green gas rolls out low along the floor in soft overlapping puffs (flat discs, no outline), bubbling and shedding glowing spores, then thins away.

items.name: toxic_puddle
items.summary: A thin 88 px lens of venom on the ground with a shimmering top row, glints and a dark lip, bubbles swelling and popping into drops, spores and faint fumes.

items.name: tracer_bolt
items.summary: A charged one-shot: a brief charge at the hand, a hot head with a long tapered tracer at 550 px/s, then a hit with a flash, a cross of light and a dotted ring.

items.name: turning_glint
items.summary: One big gold 8-ray glint that pops, turns, pulses twice and shrinks, with warm and icy mini glints, twinkles and tiny stars.

items.name: vent_bubbles
items.summary: Underwater streams from vents: lit-rim bubbles wobbling up, popping at a glinting surface, specks sinking.

items.name: volt_impact
items.summary: Electric hit: a 7-bolt star that snaps out and shrinks, a dotted ring racing out, plasma spray and static.

categories.blurb: whole attacks, wind-up to recovery, chained from the effects below
