effects.name: Arrow shot
effects.description: He raises the bow, draws to his cheek, holds his breath and looses: the string snaps forward, the arrow crosses the floor and thuds home.

effects.name: Dash strike
effects.description: A crouch, then he's across the floor in a blur of after-images and already cutting: a critical hit, a beat, and he hops back to where he started.

effects.name: Earth stomp
effects.description: A knee comes up, the boot slams down, the floor heaves under the target and a stone spike rams up through it.

effects.name: Fireball throw
effects.description: He gathers fire in his hand, leans back and hurls it: the ball flies, the target takes it in a blast and comes out charred.

effects.name: Ground pound
effects.description: He coils, leaps out of frame height, hangs, and comes down like a rock: the floor cracks, shock waves race out and throw the target about as they pass.

effects.name: Holy smite
effects.description: Both hands go up and a glint marks the target; he brings them down and a bolt of light drops like a hammer, leaving the target blanched.

effects.name: Ice lance throw
effects.description: Frost gathers into a spear in his hand, he throws it like a javelin, and the target ices over in a burst of snowflakes and shivers.

effects.name: Lightning call
effects.description: An arm goes up, a sigil lights under the target, and on the downswing a thick bolt comes down on it; the target jolts through the aftershocks.

effects.name: Meteor call
effects.description: A long chant: a circle draws itself round him, it flares, he points, and a burning rock comes down on the target and flattens the scene.

effects.name: Pistol shots
effects.description: Three aimed shots: the gun kicks up each time and settles, tracers cross the floor, and the target staggers under each hit.

effects.name: Rocket launcher
effects.description: He drops to one knee, shoulders the tube and fires: the kick shoves him back along the floor, the rocket crawls out on its jet and the target goes up.

effects.name: Sword combo
effects.description: Three strokes walking forward: a slash, a crossing double cut, and a two-handed cleave into the floor that throws the target about.

effects.name: Brazier
effects.description: An iron bowl on a tripod heaped with glowing coals and a big roaring fire, sparks and embers streaming up off it, light on the iron and the floor.

effects.name: Campfire
effects.description: Crossed logs on a bed of coals and a lively fire: tongues that lick and leap, popping sparks, embers drifting up, smoke curling off, a warm pool of light.

effects.name: Candle
effects.description: A wax candle in a brass dish: a calm flame with a blue root that sways and stretches, a halo of light, motes drifting in it, a bead of wax running down a drip.

effects.name: Fire breath
effects.description: A roaring cone of fire streaming right from the mouth: white-hot at the lips, billowing out and cooling to red and smoke at its edges, sparks thrown out ahead.

effects.name: Fire ring
effects.description: A white flash at the feet, then flames race outward along the floor in a ring, flaring as the front passes and burning down behind it over a smouldering scorch.

effects.name: Fire tornado
effects.description: A spinning funnel of fire: spiral bands turning round it, licks flung off its sides, a ring of flame whirling at its foot, embers orbiting it in and out of view.

effects.name: Fireball
effects.description: A fireball flying right: a churning white-hot head with a corona of flame, a long torn tail of flame puffs cooling into smoke, embers shed behind.

effects.name: Flame pillar
effects.description: The floor cracks and glows, a column of fire erupts white-hot and roars, spewing embers and shedding flame, then collapses into rolling smoke.

effects.name: Flamethrower
effects.description: A pressurised jet shooting right: a blue pilot at the nozzle, a tight stream with surges racing down it, a sputter, burning drops falling off, a tip that curls up into smoke.

effects.name: Meteor
effects.description: A burning rock streaks in from the upper left in a comet of fire and smashes into the floor: a white flash, a fireball, rocks and brands thrown, a glowing crater that cools.

effects.name: Spirit flame
effects.description: A cold blue-teal ghost fire floating in the air: a bright rim round a hollow dark heart, a wave climbing its wispy tail, curls breaking off, cold sparks rising.

effects.name: Torch
effects.description: A wall torch on an iron bracket: a licking flame leaping off a pitch-soaked wrap, licks and puffs torn off its tips, smoke, embers, a flickering light on the wall.

effects.name: Barrel explosion
effects.description: An explosive barrel shudders, its lid bulging and spitting flame, then blows: a fireball column, staves and the lid flying, burning fuel splashed over the floor.

effects.name: Big explosion
effects.description: A huge ground blast in three beats: a white dome, a rolling fireball that climbs into a mushrooming smoke column, heavy rocks, and fires left burning.

effects.name: Cartoon POW
effects.description: A comic-book hit: a jagged two-tone burst star slams in with a shake and boiling edges, POW! drops in letter by letter, action lines fly, then it all snaps away.

effects.name: Dirt explosion
effects.description: A buried charge goes off: a flash under the floor, a V of dirt clods and grit thrown high, a brown dust plume that billows and settles, and a crater left behind.

effects.name: Firework burst
effects.description: A shell climbs, slows and bursts into a sphere of coloured trailing stars round a gold core; they droop, crackle into white pops and fade, leaving glitter.

effects.name: Firework rocket
effects.description: A rocket fizzes off the ground on a sparkling gold trail, coasts, and bursts into a palm: heavy gold fronds arc out, droop on glittering trails and crackle at the tips.

effects.name: Grenade
effects.description: A grenade is lobbed in, bounces, rolls to a stop with its fuse fizzing, shudders, then blows: a white flash, shrapnel streaks, sparks, a small fireball and a scorch.

effects.name: Implosion
effects.description: Everything is sucked in: streaks and grit rush inward, rings contract and a dark sphere collapses onto a crushed white point; a beat of stillness, then a sharp pop.

effects.name: Nuke
effects.description: A blinding white frame, then a fireball lifts on a thin stem into a wide rolling cap that glows from inside; a white skirt flashes and a dust surge sweeps the floor.

effects.name: Plasma explosion
effects.description: A blue-violet energy blast with no smoke: a white flash, a ball of plasma swelling into a thinning shell, shock rings in and out of depth, lightning arcs crackling off it.

effects.name: Explosion
effects.description: A ground blast: a white flash and shock rings, fire that cools into a rolling smoke column, sparks, burning brands that land and keep burning, tumbling rocks and a glowing scorch.

effects.name: Smoke bomb
effects.description: A round canister clinks down, fuse sparking, and pops: thick grey-violet smoke gushes out, rolls along the floor, billows into a cloud that hides all, then thins to wisps.

effects.name: Bubbles
effects.description: Bubbles stream up from a vent of pebbles, wobbling and swelling as they rise, flare as they cross shafts of light from the surface, then dome up and pop there.

effects.name: Drip
effects.description: A bead swells under a wet stone tip and catches the light, pinches off, falls stretched by its speed and plinks into a puddle with a crown, a ring and a tiny rebound.

effects.name: Fountain
effects.description: A stone basin; a jet rises from its spout and blooms into glassy arcs that break into beads, fall back and plink into the water with rings.

effects.name: Geyser
effects.description: A pool heaves and burbles faster and faster, then blasts a white column of water skyward with a churning foam head; it rains back down in drops and steam, slumps and sputters out.

effects.name: Rain splash
effects.description: A low close-up on one puddle in the rain: big drops land in crowns that throw beads and a rebound jet, rings spread and interfere, a lamp's reflection wobbles on the water.

effects.name: Ripples
effects.description: A drop plinks on still dark water and rings spread out across it at a low angle: the swell of each ring catches the light, crests glint, and they fade into the calm.

effects.name: Splash
effects.description: A stone drops into still water: a white hit, a crown that tears into droplets arcing out to plink down with rings, a jet that bounces back, foam and drifting mist.

effects.name: Water jet
effects.description: A pressurised stream blasts right: a tight glassy rod with surges running down it that swells, roughens, bends under its weight and breaks into chunks, spray and mist.

effects.name: Water orb
effects.description: A sphere of water floats and wobbles: a current circles inside it, the floor shows upside down through it, it shines, light gathers on the floor under it, and drips fall and plink.

effects.name: Waterfall
effects.description: A river pours from a notch in a rock outcrop: a white curl, a deep sheet that splits into strands, churning foam, spray, drifting mist and rings on a dark pool.

effects.name: Wave crash
effects.description: A swell rolls in and steepens, its lip throws forward and curls over a dark barrel, then crashes into a burst of white foam and spray that surges on and fades to lace.

effects.name: Whirlpool
effects.description: Seen from above, dark water winds into a vortex: foam arms spiral in, darkening as they're drawn down into a deep eye with a lit far rim, flecks of foam circling in after them.

effects.name: Blizzard vortex
effects.description: A swirling snow tornado: wind bands spin up a leaning funnel, flakes and ice crystals orbit in front and behind, snow boils at its foot and cold light fills its throat.

effects.name: Freeze
effects.description: Frost races in and climbs the character, turning it to ice; a faceted block crystallizes round it pane by pane, glints, cracks and bursts, and the character thaws free.

effects.name: Frost breath
effects.description: A cone of icy wind blowing right: frost puffs billow out, swell and sink, wind streaks race through, ice crystals tumble and glint off a white-hot mouth.

effects.name: Frost nova
effects.description: Frost spirals into a spinning snowflake, then a wave blooms three rings of ice crystals round the caster; snow drifts, frost creeps, and the ice melts back into the floor.

effects.name: Ice crystal
effects.description: A floating ice crystal turning slowly in its own cold light: its facets brighten and darken as they turn, glints flash on them, frost motes circle it.

effects.name: Ice lance
effects.description: A faceted ice spear flying right: a light pulse runs through its core, rings of cold air shear off the tip, frost peels off into a wake and crystals shed behind it.

effects.name: Ice shatter
effects.description: A block of ice takes a hit from the left: it jolts, cracks race over its faces, it flashes white and bursts into chunks that tumble, bounce and skid off in a roll of ice dust.

effects.name: Ice spikes
effects.description: A frost line races along the floor and clusters of jagged ice blades burst up behind it in a rising wave, glint, flash white together and shatter into toppling shards.

effects.name: Icicle fall
effects.description: An icicle drips and trembles, snaps off its frosted root, drops, stabs the floor and bursts into skidding shards, splinters and rolling frost.

effects.name: Snowflake burst
effects.description: A cold pop: frost gathers and flashes white in a ring, then crisp six-armed snowflakes spin out, slow, twinkle and drift down to settle and melt.

effects.name: Ball lightning
effects.description: A crackling ball of plasma drifts on a wandering loop, spitting arcs off its skin and leaving a wake of fading motes, and zaps the floor when it dips low.

effects.name: Chain lightning
effects.description: A bolt leaps from the caster's hand through three targets in turn; each flashes, sparks and grounds itself to the floor while the arcs between them flicker, then the chain snaps.

effects.name: Charge up
effects.description: Sparks streak and arcs whip in to a crackling core at the caster's hand that swells and pulses faster, then it flashes and bursts: bolts every way, a ring, a spray of sparks.

effects.name: Electrified
effects.description: Current runs through a character: arcs crawl over and leap across the body, sparks spit off, the body flares to an electric silhouette on each jolt, and the feet ground out.

effects.name: Lightning strike
effects.description: A targeted strike: a sigil charges on the floor, the scene darkens, a thick bolt slams into it, arcs race out along the cracks it splits, the channel crumbles to a scorch.

effects.name: Plasma ball
effects.description: A glass globe on a dark pedestal: wandering plasma tendrils reach from the core to the glass and fan out in bright feet where they touch it, lighting the stand and floor.

effects.name: Spark arc
effects.description: A climbing arc between two rods: it strikes white at their narrow foot, climbs on rising heat as it stretches and bows, sputters and snaps at the top, then strikes again.

effects.name: Storm cloud
effects.description: A storm cloud boils overhead, billows lit from inside by flickering discharges, ragged scud under its flat dark base; rain slants down and once a loop a bolt cracks to the floor.

effects.name: Tesla coil
effects.description: A copper coil under a steel torus throws branching arcs that lash out in volleys and now and then strike the floor in a spray of sparks, lighting the metal and the ground.

effects.name: Thunderclap
effects.description: A thunderclap round the caster: a white flash, forked bolts burst out and stab the floor, a heavy shock ring tears across the ground raising dust and grit, sparks streak away.

effects.name: Zap hit
effects.description: A contact zap: an arc snaps in from the left, the hit point overloads into a knot of tiny crackling zigzags, a fern of burn marks glows outward, sparks jink away, ozone puffs.

effects.name: EMP blast
effects.description: A disc charge ticks, pops white, and a bubble of rolling scanlines swells out with arcs crawling its skin; it strobes, tears and shorts out into falling dead pixels.

effects.name: Energy core
effects.description: A plasma core beating in a steel cage: it swells and throws a shock ring on each beat, two tilted rings orbit it, and arcs jump to the bars and spark.

effects.name: Force field
effects.description: A glassy dome of hex plates over the hero: plates glint, tracers from the right slam into it, a ripple and cracks of light race across, sparks glance off.

effects.name: Glitch
effects.description: The hero's signal breaks up in bursts: an RGB split, slices torn sideways, rows smeared out, junk blocks and dead pixels, then snaps back clean.

effects.name: Hologram
effects.description: A floor projector throws a cone of light holding a turning wireframe model: scanlines roll through it, a data ring circles it, and it flickers, tears and jitters.

effects.name: Jetpack
effects.description: Twin thrusters fire straight down: white-hot cores with shock diamonds inside ragged flames, puffs that cool into smoke billowing below, lit by the fire.

effects.name: Laser grid
effects.description: Security lasers between two steel posts: red beams slide and scissor across, dust and haze light up only where they cut through, and the floor sweepers scorch and spark.

effects.name: Scanner
effects.description: Brackets snap onto the hero, a scan line sweeps head to toe leaving a cooling outline, and a readout counts up to OK before it all lets go.

effects.name: Teleporter pad
effects.description: A steel pad glows on the floor, its rings rippling outward; a soft column of light rises off it and rings of light lift away, sparkles drifting up through them.

effects.name: Tractor beam
effects.description: A hovering pod projects a cone of light to the floor; rocks tear loose in puffs of dust and spiral up spinning into the lens while rings of light climb the beam.

effects.name: Warp in
effects.description: A beam slams down, rings run down it and a scanline paints the hero in from head to toe, white-hot pixels cooling to their own colors; the beam pinches shut in sparks.

effects.name: Warp out
effects.description: The hero's outline flickers on, they flash white and break into light from the head down, streaming up a beam that lifts off the floor and pinches shut.

effects.name: Claw swipe
effects.description: Three claw marks rake down one after another, white-hot, cooling through orange to red, then close up from both ends and leave a dotted scar, with hot flecks and drips.

effects.name: Dagger flurry
effects.description: A flurry of small quick crescents at every angle in front of the fighter, each with a flick of sparks, finished by one big cut that glints and bursts.

effects.name: Double slash
effects.description: A down cut, then an up cut that crosses it: the moment the X closes both strokes flash white, the crossing bursts with light and sparks, and a dotted X lingers.

effects.name: Hammer smash
effects.description: A hammer drops in front in a wedge of motion: a white slam with rays, a dome of force, a dent with cracks, rocks thrown up that bounce and settle, and dust.

effects.name: Heavy cleave
effects.description: A glint over the head, then a thick ember arc accelerates over the top into the floor: a white slam, glowing cracks, dust rolling both ways, grit and rising embers.

effects.name: Scythe reap
effects.description: A slow, huge dark crescent reaps round the front with a pale ghostly edge; it hangs, then tears away from the tail into curling wisps and cold vapour.

effects.name: Spear sweep
effects.description: A wide low sweep at shin height: a long flat crescent swings from behind the legs round the front, and the wind of it kicks a wake of dust and grit along the floor.

effects.name: Spin slash
effects.description: The blade whirls once round the waist on a tilted plane, behind the body and back in front; the closed ring flares white, dissolves into a dotted trace and throws sparks.

effects.name: Sword slash
effects.description: A tilted crescent whips round in two frames, cools from white to deep blue as it trails off, glints at the tip and throws sparks.

effects.name: Thrust
effects.description: A piercing stab: a bundle of streaks shoots out from the hand to a point, a long four-point star flares at the tip with a pierce ring, sparks and speed lines.

effects.name: Uppercut
effects.description: A crescent rises from the floor past the face, and at the top a comic impact star bursts: bold outline, hot core, burst lines, twinkles and sparks.

effects.name: Whip crack
effects.description: A whip rolls out to the right as a loop running down its length, faster and faster, until the tip flips over and cracks: a white pop, a ring of air, sparks and a puff of smoke.

effects.name: Blunt hit
effects.description: A heavy, soft thud: a white-hot lumpy blob cools to cream in a warm pool of light, inked wedges jab out and snap back, a squashed ring of dust puffs swells and drifts, clods drop.

effects.name: Bullet impact
effects.description: A bullet hits a wall on the right: a hot half-star, sparks sprayed back in a cone, a puff of grit, chips that fall and bounce, a pock mark cooling to soot.

effects.name: Critical hit
effects.description: A critical hit: a jagged starburst slams in white and overshoots, a ring breaks into flying arcs, sparks streak off, shards tumble to the floor under a big flare.

effects.name: Ground slam
effects.description: Something lands hard: the floor flashes and cracks, two crescent shock waves race out along it, a dust wave and a tall dust cloud rise, rocks erupt, bounce and settle.

effects.name: Heavy landing
effects.description: A character lands hard: the floor dents and cracks under their feet, two rings of dust roll out along the floor one after the other, and pebbles hop away.

effects.name: Hit flash
effects.description: The character takes damage: a white frame, then their own colors flushed red and blinking white, cooling off, while comic hit lines jab in at them.

effects.name: Hit spark
effects.description: The everyday hit: a sharp, lopsided cross flare with one long ray along the blow round a white diamond core, then a cone of sparks and hot chips that fall and bounce.

effects.name: Impact frame
effects.description: An anime impact: two frames of white with black burst lines rushing at the hit, two frames inverted, then the lines pull out past the edges and vanish.

effects.name: Parry
effects.description: Two blades clash: their edges flash in an X, a white four-point star rings out, a ring breaks into arcs and a fan of gold sparks sprays up and rains down.

effects.name: Ricochet
effects.description: A tracer streaks down onto the floor, glances off with a white-hot star and skips away at an angle, leaving a glowing skid while sparks skitter along the ground.

effects.name: Shield block
effects.description: A blow is caught on a half-dome of energy in front of the character: its diamond lattice flashes, a ripple runs over it, sparks glance off, then it blinks out cell by cell.

effects.name: Arrow
effects.description: An arrow in flight: a steel broadhead catching the light, a wooden shaft, fletching fluttering in the wind, streaks of air peeling off its head and swirling off its feathers.

effects.name: Bullet tracer
effects.description: A white-hot slug tearing along, its tracer burning behind it in a long streak that sputters and cools from white through gold to red, shedding sparks and a thread of smoke.

effects.name: Cannon shot
effects.description: A cannon fires from a muzzle `height` px above the floor (the origin): a white flash, a tongue of flame, the ball arcing off trailing smoke, a big gunsmoke cloud rolling out.

effects.name: Energy disc
effects.description: A sawblade of crackling energy spinning flat out as it flies: hooked teeth bright on their leading edges, a white hub, spiral arms churning, sparks flung off the teeth.

effects.name: Signal flare
effects.description: A signal flare streaks up off the ground trailing sparks and smoke, bursts, and hangs as a pulsing red star that drips sparks under its own red-lit smoke, then gutters out.

effects.name: Homing missile
effects.description: A missile kicks off, arcs up, rolls over and dives onto its target (the origin), its smoke trail left hanging in the air, and hits in a fiery blast of flame, sparks and rocks.

effects.name: Laser bolt
effects.description: A red laser bolt: a white-hot core in a rounded head, red bands tapering back, pulses racing down it, a tail that shimmers apart into wavering dashes.

effects.name: Magic missile
effects.description: Motes gather into an arcane orb at a hand `height` px above the floor (the origin); it weaves to its target trailing a twisting ribbon and bursts into a star of light.

effects.name: Pistol shot
effects.description: One pistol shot from a muzzle `height` px above the floor (the origin): a spiky white-cored flash, sparks, a curl of smoke hooking up and back, a casing that bounces and settles.

effects.name: Shotgun blast
effects.description: A shotgun blast from a muzzle `height` px above the floor (the origin): a wide ragged fan of flame, pellet streaks, a heavy rolling smoke cloud, a red shell kicked out on the pump.

effects.name: SMG burst
effects.description: Sustained fire at twelve rounds a second: each shot a different spiky flash with a white core, sparks, smoke wisps piling up and drifting, brass casings bouncing on the floor.

effects.name: Plasma shot
effects.description: A glowing plasma blob: hot knots churning in its core, a corona crackling over its skin, its tail necking into droplets that tear off, cool and wink out behind.

effects.name: Rocket
effects.description: A steel rocket roars along: a flickering jet with shock diamonds and a white-hot nozzle, a thick billowing smoke trail lit by the flame, sparks shed behind.

effects.name: Coin drop
effects.description: An enemy goes up in a soft poof and gold coins spin out of it, bounce with a glint on each hit, settle on the floor, twinkle, and wink out one by one.

effects.name: Disintegrate
effects.description: The character crackles with light, flashes white, then peels away from the head down: each pixel flares white-hot and streams off on the wind as a cooling mote of light.

effects.name: Dissolve burn
effects.description: An ember seam lights at the feet and climbs the body: above it the body scorches and smoulders, at it flames lick up, below it there's only falling ash, embers and smoke.

effects.name: Egg hatch
effects.description: A speckled egg rocks three times, each rock cracking it further with warm light leaking out, then pops: light pours out of the opening and lit shell halves tumble away.

effects.name: Poof
effects.description: A cartoon death poof: a white pop, a ring of soft round smoke balls bursting out between speed lines, little stars spinning off, and the cloud lifting and thinning away.

effects.name: Respawn beam
effects.description: A guide line drops, a pillar of light slams onto the spot, and a scan bar climbs from the feet writing the character back in row by row, white-hot lines cooling to its colors.

effects.name: Shatter death
effects.description: Frost races up the body and seals it in faceted ice, a glint sweeps it, cracks spread from the chest, then it bursts into its own facets that tumble, bounce and melt.

effects.name: Soul rise
effects.description: The body's outline flares and dims, then a pale glowing copy of it lifts out, stretching as its legs melt into a rippling wisp, shedding motes until it thins into light.

effects.name: Spawn portal
effects.description: A rift tears open on the floor and swirls, belches violet smoke and sparks, spits a fountain of wisps up out of itself, then twists shut with a pop.

effects.name: Summon rise
effects.description: A rune circle burns into the floor, the ground bursts, and a horned brute heaves up out of it through dust and rubble, lit from below, until its eyes flare.

effects.name: Arcane beam
effects.description: A beam fires right from the hand: a white core, strands twisting round it, pulses running down it, a flaring source and an end that sprays sparks.

effects.name: Arcane missiles
effects.description: A volley of violet bolts fans out of the hand, curls round on twisting ribbons and pops on the target one after another.

effects.name: Arcane orb
effects.description: A floating orb of smoky violet glass with a swirl turning round a white-hot heart, two tilted rings of light orbiting behind and in front.

effects.name: Blink in
effects.description: Glittering bits spiral in to a point of light that opens into a line, then into a white silhouette that cools into the caster.

effects.name: Blink out
effects.description: The caster crackles with gathering light, flashes white, squeezes into a line of light that collapses and pops away in sparks.

effects.name: Magic circle cast
effects.description: A circle draws itself on the floor, runes ignite one by one, it flashes, and a column of light fires up and breaks apart into glints.

effects.name: Mana burst
effects.description: Energy rushes into a point and blows out in a white flash and rings, flinging glowing runes that flare and pop into sparks one after another.

effects.name: Portal
effects.description: An upright rift: fibrous spiral arms wind down into the dark, a lit rim wobbles, motes and streaks are pulled in, the floor glows.

effects.name: Rune circle
effects.description: A rune circle turns on the floor in perspective: a carousel of runes lit by chasing light, a turning square, ticks, motes rising off it.

effects.name: Spell charge
effects.description: Energy gathers in the caster's hand: streaks and motes spiral in, rings collapse into a swelling orb that crackles with arcs, ready to fire.

effects.name: Star fall
effects.description: Stars streak down on long trails across an area, each landing with a white flash, a ring across the floor and a kick of sparks.

effects.name: Time stop
effects.description: A clock face springs open, ticks slower and slower, freezes drained of colour, cracks, then shatters into falling shards.

effects.name: Blessing
effects.description: A soft cone of light rests on the character from above; sparkles drift down through it, twinkling, and wink out where they land on the head and shoulders.

effects.name: Divine shield
effects.description: A bubble of gold light round the character: a bright rim and a thin gold film, meridians turning like a slow globe, a sheen sweeping across and sparkles winking on it.

effects.name: Feather burst
effects.description: A white puff pops and throws feathers that brake hard, then rock from side to side as they sink and fade, with down drifting after them.

effects.name: Halo
effects.description: A ring of gold light floats over the head with a glint running round it; fine dust sifts down from it and the head catches its light.

effects.name: Heal
effects.description: Petals of light bloom under the feet, a hoop of light rises up the body restoring its colour and leaving sparkles, and motes spiral up and pop into tiny hearts.

effects.name: Healing ring
effects.description: A seed of green light sinks into the floor and a soft ring rolls out from it; the floor glows where it passes and plus signs sprout and float up.

effects.name: Holy pillar
effects.description: Light breaks through from above: a sun opens at the top and a fan of shafts converges on the mark, pulsing, while a sigil burns on the floor; then the fan folds shut.

effects.name: Resurrection
effects.description: Light pours down on the fallen and life climbs back up the body; wings of light unfold, a halo forms, one great wingbeat, then the wings scatter into feathers.

effects.name: Smite
effects.description: A glint marks the spot, then a bolt of light drops like a hammer: a white flash, a shockwave over the floor, stone chips flying and cracks that glow and cool.

effects.name: Sunburst
effects.description: A white-hot core in a gold corona; long and short rays turn slowly round it, breathing, with glints running out along them that wink at the tips.

effects.name: Black hole
effects.description: A tilted disk of banded rings turns round a black hole, its far side bent up over the top and under the bottom; debris spirals in, stretches and is swallowed.

effects.name: Curse
effects.description: Wisps gather over the head, a skull stamps down with a flash, its eyes burn as the curse floods the body violet, then it cracks and crumbles.

effects.name: Dark explosion
effects.description: Motes swirl into a pulsing core, a black star cuts across a violet-white flash, and a black sphere burns at the rim, throws lit shards and smoke, then collapses.

effects.name: Eclipse
effects.description: A black moon over the sun: a breathing pearl corona with long streamers, a thin white rim, and one diamond bead blazing on its edge.

effects.name: Grasping hands
effects.description: Shadow arms burst up out of a dark pool with a splash, clench their hands into claws, strain, and are dragged back under, fingers clawing at the air.

effects.name: Hex sigil
effects.description: A burning pen traces a cursed sigil in the air, its glyphs pop in one by one, then it flares white and crumbles into falling embers.

effects.name: Life steal
effects.description: A target on the right is struck and bleeds red orbs; they hang a moment, then whip home as comet streaks and flood the caster crimson.

effects.name: Necro skulls
effects.description: Spectral skulls circle a cold green flame on a tilted orbit, passing behind and before it, eyes lit, trailing curls of ghost smoke.

effects.name: Shadow flames
effects.description: Inside-out fire on the floor: a black heart wrapped in violet flame with pale skin and tips, shedding embers and dark smoke.

effects.name: Shadow tendrils
effects.description: A dark pool opens on the floor; tentacles with lit rims and hooked tips lash up out of it with a splash, writhe, and sink back as it closes.

effects.name: Soul drain
effects.description: Pale souls are torn loose on the right and dragged down a funnel of streaks into a black crystal vessel, which flares violet as each one lands.

effects.name: Void orb
effects.description: A black orb hangs in the air, a pale rim crawling round it; a dark vortex winds into it, motes and streaks are pulled in, and light bends round its edge.

effects.name: Bleeding
effects.description: Bleeding out: beads swell at three wounds, run, let go and fall to spatter into a glossy pool that ripples; each heartbeat spurts a little and flashes the body red.

effects.name: Burning
effects.description: Burning over time: small flames lick from four hot spots, trailing sparks and thin smoke; every 0.6 s they flare, the body flashes white then orange, scorch marks spread.

effects.name: Charmed
effects.description: Smitten: a big heart beats over the head, throwing a ring and a flush of light with every beat, little hearts float up, the eyes go pink and the cheeks blush.

effects.name: Confused
effects.description: Head in a spin: a glowing spiral whirls over the head, question marks pop up round it and bob, the eyes dart left and right.

effects.name: Cursed
effects.description: Hexed: violet smoke rises off the body in winding trails, a dark stain creeps up from the feet with a glowing edge, the eyes burn, a skull glitches in overhead.

effects.name: Frozen
effects.description: Chilled to the bone: frost ferns creep over the body, icicles hang from chin and hands and drip, breath steams, snow settles, a shiver every second, frost spreads underfoot.

effects.name: Haste
effects.description: Sped up: striped after-images stream out behind, speed lines whip past, dust kicks off the heels and the leading edge catches the wind. Faces right.

effects.name: Petrified
effects.description: Turned to stone: grey creeps up from the feet behind a crackling edge that spits grit, the statue holds, cracks run through it, and it bursts into tumbling chunks and dust.

effects.name: Poisoned
effects.description: Sick to the bone: green rolls up the body in waves, dark veins creep from a wound, toxic sweat drips and hisses; every 0.8 s it wobbles, blisters pop and a ring pulses out.

effects.name: Rage
effects.description: Seething: the body judders on every heartbeat, an anger mark throbs at the temple, eyes burn, steam jets off the head, stress lines flash out and the floor cracks hot underfoot.

effects.name: Sleep
effects.description: Fast asleep: eyes shut, soft outlined Zs float up off the head one after another, swaying and growing as they rise, dream motes drift, a slow breathing glow.

effects.name: Slowed
effects.description: Dragged through time: a glassy clock dial behind the head ticks round in heavy steps, flashing with each, while drops sink in slow motion and spread slow rings.

effects.name: Stunned
effects.description: Seeing stars: three spinning stars and two little birds circle the head on a tilted ring, ducking behind it and sweeping round in front, trailing glitter.

effects.name: Acid splash
effects.description: A gob of acid bursts into a crown and spatters; it eats a glowing, smoking pit into the floor and boils down into it, spitting bright beads, pale steam curling off.

effects.name: Boulder
effects.description: A spinning boulder arcs right shedding dust and pebbles, smashes into the floor in a white flash and bursts into tumbling chunks, gravel and rolling dust.

effects.name: Earth spike
effects.description: The floor cracks with light and heaves, a faceted stone spike rams up with two side shards in a burst of chips, grit and dust; rubble rains, then it splits and crumbles.

effects.name: Healing bloom
effects.description: A sprout pushes up and unfurls, a bud swells and opens round a glowing golden heart in a flare of healing light; its petals lift away one by one as motes.

effects.name: Leaf storm
effects.description: Leaves tumble up a rising spiral round the character, passing behind and in front, turning and flipping, wrapped in bright bands of wind; litter swirls at their feet.

effects.name: Poison cloud
effects.description: A miasma hugging the floor: ragged sheets of gas lit yellow-green from within, fading to violet, creep out in tongues that curl over at their tips; plumes twist up as ribbons.

effects.name: Quake
effects.description: The ground jolts three times: a rift tears out along the floor glowing deep inside, slabs of floor heave up and drop back askew, pebbles hop and dust bursts out of the split.

effects.name: Root snare
effects.description: The floor cracks and roots burst up round the character, spiralling round its legs; they cinch tight with a snap, hold, then crack and crumble into bark and dust.

effects.name: Spore burst
effects.description: A toadstool pushes up, swells and trembles as its gills glow, then squashes and puffs a lumpy cloud of glowing spores that billows up and drifts down twinkling.

effects.name: Thorns
effects.description: A seam races along the floor and hooked thorns punch up out of it one after another, each bigger than the last, in bursts of dirt and green light; they hold, then sink.

effects.name: Tornado
effects.description: A snaking funnel of spinning wind bands under a flared, churning top that flickers with lightning; leaves and debris whirl round it front and back, dust boils at its foot.

effects.name: Toxic puddle
effects.description: Black tar lit from inside by chartreuse veins and a glowing rim, an oily sheen drifting on it; glossy bubbles dome, stretch and pop, vapour curls up in fraying ribbons.

effects.name: Vine whip
effects.description: A thorny vine bursts from the floor, rears back coiled, then lashes out right in a whip crack that sprays sap and tears off leaves, before sliding back into the ground.

effects.name: Aurora
effects.description: Rippling curtains of green-to-violet light over a starfield: folding hems burn bright, rays shimmer up into violet, and the whole sky slowly breathes.

effects.name: Blizzard
effects.description: Snow driven almost flat by a gale: streaks at three depths race past, gusts throw translucent sheets of snow across the sky and spindrift streams off the drifts.

effects.name: Cherry blossoms
effects.description: Pink petals flutter down on a spring breeze, tumbling in little spirals and flashing as they catch the light, with a few whole blossoms spinning among them.

effects.name: Clouds
effects.description: Layers of clouds drift past a bright moon at night: silver-lit tops, dark bellies, edges that flare where they cross the moon, forming and thinning as they go.

effects.name: Falling leaves
effects.description: Autumn leaves swing down through the air, tilting and flipping to show their pale backs, ride a gust, land flat in the litter and fade.

effects.name: Fireflies
effects.description: Fireflies wander over a meadow at night, each glowing up and fading on its own rhythm, trailing light and lighting the grass tips beneath them.

effects.name: Fog
effects.description: Slow banks of moonlit fog at three depths drift past each other, crests catching the light, while thin streaks of mist slide by in front.

effects.name: God rays
effects.description: Shafts of light slant down from high on the left, breathing and swaying, pooling on the floor, as drifting dust motes light up whenever they cross a beam.

effects.name: Rain
effects.description: Slanted rain at four depths: far drops fade into the dark, near ones glint and splash, drops ring the puddles and a low mist drifts over the wet floor.

effects.name: Shooting stars
effects.description: Meteors burn across a starry sky, white heads trailing gold and rose; the big ones flare and break up, and each leaves a glowing train that twists and fades.

effects.name: Snow
effects.description: Snow at three depths in a gusty breeze: far specks, drifting flakes, big near crystals that spin and glow; they settle on a sparkling drift and melt away.

effects.name: Storm
effects.description: Driving rain at two depths under a churning cloud deck; a forked bolt strikes in a double flash that lights the sky and the rain, then sheet lightning glows in the clouds.

effects.name: Achievement
effects.description: A toast slides in on speed lines and settles; a gold medal pops onto it in a burst of sparkles, a shine sweeps the whole toast, then it slides away.

effects.name: Coin collect
effects.description: A coin bursts into a fountain of spinning coins that hang, then zip one by one into a HUD counter that pops and ticks up, glints and folds away.

effects.name: Combo counter
effects.description: x5 COMBO rockets in on streaming speed lines, smearing, and slams to a stop: a white flash, a ring, sparks; it pulses while a timer bar drains, then whooshes out.

effects.name: Confetti
effects.description: Two party poppers bang one after the other: paper bits and curly streamers burst out, stall, then tumble and flutter down, flipping, and settle on the floor.

effects.name: Countdown
effects.description: 3, 2, 1 slam into a timer ring that drains like a burning fuse, throwing sparks; then GO! bursts out as the ring blows into a shockwave with rays.

effects.name: Crit number
effects.description: CRIT 128! slams in huge and white over a jagged starburst with a hard shake and speed lines, cools to fire, holds with a shine, then pops into sparks.

effects.name: Damage number
effects.description: A red -27 punches out of a hit spark, white for a frame, arcs up, lands with a squash and a little hop, then fades as it lifts away.

effects.name: Exclamation
effects.description: A bold ! springs up off the hero's head, stretching as it shoots up and squashing as it lands; surprise ticks flick out, it wobbles, then pops away.

effects.name: Health bar hit
effects.description: A segmented health bar takes a hit: it jolts and dips, the lost chunk flashes white and sheds chips, holds, then drains away behind a sparking edge.

effects.name: Heart lost
effects.description: A HUD heart is hit: it flashes white and jolts, a crack runs down it, it splits into two halves that tumble away, leaving an empty socket that fades.

effects.name: Level up
effects.description: Gold gathers at the feet and bursts up as a pillar of light round the hero; rings climb it, LEVEL UP! drops in letter by letter, a shine sweeps it, sparkles twinkle.

effects.name: Quest complete
effects.description: A stitched ribbon unrolls from the middle, QUEST COMPLETE types on letter by letter, a gold seal stamps down and ticks, stars pop; then it all rolls away.

effects.name: Chest open
effects.description: A banded chest rattles with gold light leaking from its seam, the lid kicks open, rays fan up, and coins and gems arc out, bounce, glint and get collected.

effects.name: Coin spin
effects.description: A thick gold coin turning on its edge: an embossed star face, a reeded rim showing as it goes edge-on, a flash sweeping the face, bobbing over its shadow.

effects.name: Collect burst
effects.description: The moment of pickup: a white flash and a cross of light, a thin ring snapping out ahead of a softer one, twinkles thrown wide on curving paths that brake, hang and wink out.

effects.name: Crystal shard
effects.description: A broken amber shard hovers and sways: chipped uneven faces, its top sheared off, light pulsing up through glowing cracks and flaring out of the break; splinters orbit it.

effects.name: Gem spin
effects.description: A brilliant-cut ruby turning on its axis: real facets catch the light in turn, flashes roll over the crown, refracted light slides across the floor, sparkles wink round it.

effects.name: Heart pickup
effects.description: A plump glossy heart hovering over its shadow beats lub-dub: a big squash and stretch, a smaller echo, light and a thin ring pulsing out, tiny hearts drifting off.

effects.name: Key glint
effects.description: An ornate silver key hovering and rocking; a glint runs from its bow down the shaft to the teeth and bursts off the tip as falling sparks.

effects.name: Loot beam
effects.description: A dropped sword in a tall pillar of rarity light: a white core thinning to the sky, rings pulsing across the floor, motes streaming up, a glint racing up the shaft.

effects.name: Potion
effects.description: A round glass flask of glowing brew rocks in the air: the brew sloshes behind the rock, bubbles rise and pop, light glows through the glass, wisps curl off the cork.

effects.name: Power star
effects.description: A fat bevelled star rocks side to side and swells on each beat, rays of light turning slowly behind it, sparks spinning off its points.

effects.name: XP orb
effects.description: A small glowing orb races a figure-eight, a comet tail tapering behind it along its path, flecks shed from the tail winking out, its light following it over the floor.

effects.name: Blinds
effects.description: Slats catch the light edge-on, then tilt shut top to bottom, lit rims glinting as warm light squeezes through the closing gaps with dust in it; then they tilt open and fade.

effects.name: Burn away
effects.description: The screen burns in from its edges behind a ragged ember line of licking flames, embers and smoke; then the black smoulders and burns open from the middle.

effects.name: CRT off
effects.description: The picture squeezes into a white-hot glowing line, the line into a dot that lingers as a fading afterglow; then it switches back on, dot to line to picture, with a warm-up glow.

effects.name: Diamond wipe
effects.description: A wave of faceted diamonds swells across the screen, rims bright and ridges lit, cooling to black as they lock; then they rise as gems again and shrink away with glints.

effects.name: Glitch wipe
effects.description: Torn bands of black stutter across the screen, freezing and jerking back, their ragged edges split into magenta and cyan ghosts spitting data slivers; then they tear on through.

effects.name: Iris
effects.description: A lit iris closes onto a warm spotlight where dust drifts, holds as its rim twinkles, snaps shut into a glint, then pops open from a flash with a white-hot rim throwing sparks.

effects.name: Pixel dissolve
effects.description: Clumps of blocks wink in, each drawn in a white outline that fills black and cools, with glints; then they wink out, outlines collapsing, the last small ones sparkling away.

effects.name: Shatter wipe
effects.description: A dark glass pane drops over the screen and bounces; cracks race out from an impact with a flash, then it bursts into tumbling glass shards with lit edges that fall away.

effects.name: Slash wipe
effects.description: A white-hot blade edge slices across the screen, light ahead of it and sparks spraying back over the cover; a second cut flashes through and the cover splits apart.

effects.name: Star iris
effects.description: A five-point star iris spins shut on the middle of the screen, its gold rim lit and its tips twinkling and shedding motes; it closes on a glint and spins open again from a flash.

effects.name: Bat
effects.description: A bat flaps in four snappy wing frames along a figure-eight, its body lifting on each downbeat, moonlight on its wing bones, red eyes glowing and glinting.

effects.name: Bird
effects.description: A songbird flies in place: bursts of wingbeats that lift its body on each downstroke, a glide on spread wings, its tail fanning, a loose feather drifting away.

effects.name: Butterfly
effects.description: An iridescent butterfly wanders a loop in bursts of quick wingbeats and open-winged glides, its veined, spotted wings shedding a twinkling trail of glowing dust.

effects.name: Eyeball
effects.description: A bloodshot eyeball floats in its fleshy lids: its glowing iris snaps from one look to the next, it blinks, and its nerve sways behind it as it bobs.

effects.name: Fish school
effects.description: A school of fish holds station in two depth rows: bodies wag into swinging tails, one darts ahead now and then, bubbles rise and caustic light ripples over them.

effects.name: Flying skull
effects.description: A cracked bone skull bobs in the air, jaw chattering, eyes burning, a fire roaring off its crown that sheds flame puffs, embers and smoke and throws warm light.

effects.name: Frog
effects.description: A frog puffs its throat, blinks, crouches and leaps to snap a buzzing fly out of the air, then lands with a squash and a puff of dust, gulps and settles.

effects.name: Ghost
effects.description: A sheet ghost bobs over the floor: its scalloped hem ripples and trails its drift, little arms flutter, it glances about and blinks, motes trickle off its hem.

effects.name: Jellyfish
effects.description: A see-through jellyfish pulses: its bell squeezes to shove it up and relaxes as it sinks, frilled arms and long tentacles trailing, a glow inside, bubbles drifting by.

effects.name: Slime
effects.description: A glossy slime hops in place: it squashes to wind up, stretches into the jump, rounds out in the air, splats down flinging droplets that creep back, then wobbles and blinks.

effects.name: Snake
effects.description: A snake slithers along the floor, head raised: humps rise and roll back down its patterned body to the tail, dust puffs where it touches down, its forked tongue flicks.

effects.name: Wisp
effects.description: A will-o'-the-wisp loops a figure-eight over the floor: a little soul-flame with a face, its flame tail licking up and streaming behind, shedding puffs and sparks.

effects.name: Blazing Fireball
effects.description: A trailing fireball bursts into bright arcs and sparks, leaving fading cracks on contact.

effects.name: Plasma Dart
effects.description: A bright arrow flies with blue lightning and tiny sparks behind it.

effects.name: Frostcrystal Dart
effects.description: A cluster of sharp ice flies forward, shedding little ice pieces and frost.

effects.name: Runic Crystal Missiles
effects.description: Three magic crystals circle as they fly, trailing glowing shapes.

effects.name: Threadwoven Beam
effects.description: A steady beam has light swirling around it and sparks where it hits.

effects.name: Ringpulse Ray
effects.description: Glowing balls light up along a beam as rings travel forward.

effects.name: Charged Light Cannon
effects.description: Light gathers before a steady blast fires, with flashes and rings where it hits.

effects.name: Forked Lightning Stream
effects.description: Blue-white lightning connects two ends, with little branches and sparks at the hit.

effects.name: Healing Sigil
effects.description: A magic pattern sends out rings of light and floating crosses for healing.

effects.name: Flame-Etched Ground
effects.description: Red cracks glow on the ground as flames keep rising and fading.

effects.name: Sixfold Frost Sigil
effects.description: A snowflake-shaped magic pattern lights outward, with ice sparkling above it.

effects.name: Runic Mesh Barrier
effects.description: A half-round shield rises from the ground with glowing squares on its surface.

effects.name: White-Hot Fireburst
effects.description: A fireball bursts with a ring of smoke, then cools into smoke and little embers.

effects.name: Lightning Arc Burst
effects.description: Blue-white light bursts into branching lightning, then fades to scattered flashes.

effects.name: Dust-Raising Shockwave
effects.description: A ring of dust rushes outward, lifting clouds before small stones fall back down.

effects.name: Shattering Frostburst
effects.description: Cracks light up on ice pillars before they burst into flying ice pieces.

effects.name: Leaf-Swept Vortex
effects.description: Wind spirals upward, carrying leaves through its center and drawing in dust.

effects.name: Sand-Swept Vortex
effects.description: Bands of sand spiral upward around an open center, with grit flying nearby.

effects.name: Flame-Swept Vortex
effects.description: Orange flames spiral upward, lighting the dust and smoke below.

effects.name: Runic Ring Vortex
effects.description: Glowing bands spiral upward as magic symbols move around the open center.

effects.name: Billowing Smoke Column
effects.description: Puffs of smoke rise, spread out and fade as they climb.

effects.name: Ground-Hugging Mist
effects.description: Low fog spreads across the ground, adding mystery and hiding low areas.

effects.name: Rising Steam Jet
effects.description: A narrow jet of steam shoots upward and spreads into mist at the top.

effects.name: Dispersing Smoke Puff
effects.description: A puff swells and fades, useful when something appears, vanishes or lands.

effects.name: Surging Flame Tide
effects.description: A wide fan of flames rolls upward, breaking into little embers at the edges.

effects.name: Crystal-Toothed Ice Wheel
effects.description: An ice wheel with sharp teeth spins quickly and leaves frost behind.

effects.name: Floating Rune Matrix
effects.description: A square magic pattern connects piece by piece while floating symbols rearrange.

effects.name: Vortex Lightning Strike
effects.description: Light gathers above, then blue-white lightning strikes the ground with sparks.

effects.name: Solar Halo Beam
effects.description: A round symbol fires a steady pillar of light with petal-like flashes where it hits.

effects.name: Hooked Binding Sigil
effects.description: Hook-shaped magic marks glow while curved bands tighten like a binding spell.

effects.name: Thornvine Blossom Crown
effects.description: Thorny vines grow from a magic pattern, opening leaves and glowing flowers.

effects.name: Afterimage Glaive
effects.description: A curved blade twists forward, leaving shadows that break apart and vanish.

effects.name: Breaking Tidal Surge
effects.description: A wave rolls outward, breaking into foam and droplets along its edge.

effects.name: Sand-Gathering Sigil
effects.description: Sand piles rise and collapse inside a magic triangle as nearby sand flows inward.

effects.name: Astral Ring Detonation
effects.description: Starlight circles inward, squeezes together and bursts into bright trails.

effects.name: Spiraling Wind Spear
effects.description: Spinning wind rushes forward like a spear, leaving a trail that narrows and fades.

effects.name: Bubbling Venom Sigil
effects.description: A green magic pattern bubbles with poison, making ripples and low mist as bubbles pop.

effects.name: Molten Vein Fissure
effects.description: Glowing cracks spread along the ground, lifting stones before fading to small embers.

effects.name: Prismatic Crystal Bulwark
effects.description: Crystal shield pieces form a curved wall, then fold away one by one when stopped.

effects.name: Prismatic Crystal Block
effects.description: A bright line flashes as a small crystal shield blocks a hit and scatters light.

effects.name: Gate of Astral Tracery
effects.description: A glowing doorway opens piece by piece, with flowing stars inside, then closes when stopped.

effects.name: Dark Energy Siphon
effects.description: Streams of dark magic flow back from the target and finish draining when stopped.

effects.name: Vitality Blossom
effects.description: Soft light gathers low down and blooms upward like a flower for revival or healing.

effects.name: Falling Frost Spear Array
effects.description: Ice spears fall one after another, shatter on landing and leave fading frost.

effects.name: Corrosive Venom Jet
effects.description: Poison sprays toward a target with splashing drops, finishing its flow when stopped.

effects.name: Windswept Meadow
effects.description: Painted-looking grass dotted with white flowers sways gently in the wind.

effects.name: Rift-Shattering Slashes
effects.description: A slash makes the background split like broken glass, spread apart and slowly return.

effects.name: Luminous Vortex Black Hole
effects.description: Light spirals into a black hole while the scenery behind it appears to bend.

effects.name: Azure Blade Sweep
effects.description: A blue-white slash sweeps almost a full circle, pauses, then closes from tail to tip.

effects.name: Gleaming Blade Trail
effects.description: Swinging a sword leaves a see-through blue trail that quickly fades when you stop.

effects.name: Riftblade Sweep
effects.description: A clear curved slash stretches and shifts the scenery behind it, then fades away.

effects.name: Riftblade Trail
effects.description: A sword swing leaves a clear trail that bends the view behind it and quickly fades.

effects.name: Darkchain Sigil Rupture
effects.description: Magic circles draw chains and smoke toward a dark ball, which shrinks and bursts with red-purple lightning.

effects.name: Golden-Bladed Lightning Arrow
effects.description: A golden arrow flies wrapped in lightning, bursting into flashes and two rings on impact.

effects.name: Golden Chain Rain
effects.description: Golden chains fall in three waves, bursting into gold shards on contact; glowing cracks release slowly rising fragments.

effects.name: Billowing Airburst
effects.description: A fireball bursts in midair with thick smoke trails, then cools into fading smoke.

effects.name: Red Circle Spell Indicator
effects.description: A red circle marks danger and fills as an attack approaches, disappearing when the countdown ends.

effects.name: Red Sector Spell Indicator
effects.description: A red fan marks an attack direction and fills as it approaches. Its size and angle can change.

effects.name: Sacred Relic Descent
effects.description: A layered white-gold magic circle turns as a triangular pyramid lands with flying rocks, followed by flowing waves and raised smoke every two seconds.

effects.name: Impact Frame
effects.description: Flash comic silhouettes and stars on a hit, then erupt from darkness into a powerful final blast.

effects.name: Verdant Restoration
effects.description: A nature-themed healing effect with soft green light and drifting leaves around a target, showing ongoing recovery.

effects.name: Aegis Weave
effects.description: A magic shield effect with a clear blue barrier around a target, showing a protected state.

effects.name: Sustained Arc
effects.description: A sustained lightning effect with branching currents linking the source to a target, suited to ongoing electric attacks.

effects.name: Starblade Cataclysm
effects.description: A sword becomes golden stars, gathers into a four-petal core, then fires a beam that burns a lava trench.

effects.name: Thousand Petal Blades
effects.description: A sword sinks into the ground, giant blades rise and shatter into countless pink petal blades that scatter, spiral, then wrap the target in a sphere and crush it with crossing slashes.

effects.name: Cinder Edge
effects.description: The blazing sword suddenly pulls all its fire into a razor edge and the air shimmers; one swing sends a giant arc of flame across the field, scorching the ground as ash drifts up.

effects.name: Frost Wing Surge
effects.description: Huge ice wings and a tail unfold behind the caster; ice spikes erupt one after another towards the target, crystals creep over it from the contact point and shatter.

effects.name: White Silence
effects.description: The caster turns pure white and colour drains from the scene; one swing sends a translucent frost sphere racing outwards, white fog rolls in, everything freezes into white crystal, holds still, then shatters.

effects.name: Ink Tide Binding
effects.description: The caster slowly spreads both arms, the world darkens and black water floods out from their feet with floating ink; finally glowing white threads wrap the target and snap tight.

effects.name: Crescent Fang
effects.description: The caster raises the blade as black energy wraps them; one swing releases a giant black crescent with a blue-white edge that ploughs the ground and bursts into an upright shock ring.

effects.name: Violet Fusion
effects.description: A blue orb and a red orb form at either side of the caster, spiral together and fuse into a huge violet sphere with a white-hot core that pushes forward, warping space and gouging a trench.

effects.name: Endless Starfield
effects.description: The caster makes a sign; after a blackout the whole frame becomes endless space: layered twinkling stars, drifting nebulae and giant slowly turning rings, with the target floating, frozen.

effects.name: Shrine of Cuts
effects.description: A huge eerie shrine rises out of black smoke behind the caster and the scene turns blood red; random slash lines appear everywhere, in the air, on the ground and on the target, and debris flies.

effects.name: Shadow Marsh
effects.description: Liquid black shadow spreads from the caster's feet over the ground; it bulges in several places and shadow arms and beast heads burst out to strike, then sink back in.

effects.name: Caldera Domain
effects.description: The battlefield becomes the inside of a volcano: rock walls rise all around, the floor cracks into lava, magma erupts and fireballs fly from the walls and the sky at the target.

effects.name: Crimson Spark Fist
effects.description: The caster dashes in with a punch; on contact a black radial burst and dark red lightning explode, the frame freezes and flips to a two-tone negative, a short hard shake, speed lines everywhere.

effects.name: Abyss Flame Dragon
effects.description: The caster thrusts an arm out, black fire coils and erupts into a long giant dragon of black flame that snakes across the field, jaws open, onto the target, shedding violet sparks.

effects.name: Finger Bolt
effects.description: The caster forms a finger gun; motes gather into a blazing blue ball at the fingertip that fires as a fast blue beam with a muzzle flash and bursts into a spherical blast on hit.

effects.name: Spiral Palm Wave
effects.description: The caster gathers energy, aura rings coil and spiral upwards, the light compresses into the palms, and a double palm strike releases a widening cone wave that lands as a circular pressure ring.

effects.name: Golden Aura Armor
effects.description: Golden light seeps out of the caster into a bright protective flow, then forms energy armour piece by piece; vertical light streaks, floating gold dust, regular pulse rings, and golden afterimages when moving.

effects.name: Thorn Bloom
effects.description: The caster throws a seed; vines burst from the ground and wrap the target, covered in thorns, and a giant thorn flower opens its serrated petals and snaps shut on it as petals and leaves scatter.

effects.name: Bat Bomb Barrage
effects.description: The caster releases bat-shaped magic bombs that circle the target trailing black smoke, then dive in one by one in a chain of explosions that ends in one big shockwave.

effects.name: Gale Shuriken
effects.description: A blue-white ball spins in the palm and grows four giant wind blades; thrown, it trails a spiral of air and on impact swells into a huge spinning storm full of tiny cuts.

effects.name: Spirit Colossus
effects.description: A giant glowing skeleton rises around the caster, grows muscle and armour into a translucent violet energy giant, and the giant swings a huge blade in a sweeping band of light.

effects.name: Gravity Core
effects.description: The caster cups a tiny black orb and throws it up; the ground cracks and rocks fly in from all sides, orbit the core, and pack into a giant sphere of stone.

effects.name: Repulse Sphere
effects.description: The caster hovers and slowly opens both hands; then a huge transparent sphere of force bursts from them, warping space, flinging rocks outwards and pushing a ring of dust as the camera pulls back.

effects.name: Crimson Dragon Dash
effects.description: Thick red steam pours off the caster and gathers into a giant dragon silhouette; they dash and the dragon charges with them into a crushing kick that compresses into a point of light, then explodes.

effects.name: Black Flame Curse
effects.description: The caster stares at the target and opaque black flames burst from its surface, writhing upwards and spreading with glowing magenta edges, black embers rising and a burning zone left on the ground.

effects.name: Eclipse Slash
effects.description: A pitch-black crescent slash that lands with a storm of red lightning and erupts into a black sphere of force. An original combination of the crescent slash and the black-red impact.

effects.name: Crystal Requiem
effects.description: Thousands of crystals circle the target, are pulled in by a central gravity and pack layer by layer into a giant crystal sphere that bursts. An original combination of the blade swarm and the gravity core.

effects.name: Echo Dragon
effects.description: A dragon of rushing wind streaks across the field and on impact the whole dragon breaks apart into hundreds of spinning wind blades that cut outwards. An original combination of the energy dragon and the wind blades.

effects.name: Void Frost Burial
effects.description: The field drops into dark space with a black mirror floor; white ice crystals grow up from under the target until it is encased, then everything shatters. An original combination of the starfield domain and the white freeze.

effects.name: Skyfall
effects.description: The sky turns red and a meteor larger than the frame drops slowly while its shadow spreads over the horde; the impact ring throws the crowd outwards in order of distance and leaves a crater with glowing lava cracks.

effects.name: Judgment Lances
effects.description: The caster raises a hand and a lock-on sigil lights up over every enemy one by one; after a one-beat pause dozens of light pillars fall at once and the enemies dissolve into white light.

effects.name: Sword Rain
effects.description: A wide formation of light swords opens in the sky; the swords drop one by one into the horde, then a giant sword lands in the centre and blasts the rest away.

effects.name: Glacier March
effects.description: Ice spikes spread forward from the caster in a fan and freeze the horde into statues one by one; the field holds still for a beat, the caster snaps their fingers and every statue shatters at once.

effects.name: Firestorm Tide
effects.description: A wall of fire many times taller than a person rolls out from the caster across the whole field; every enemy it swallows becomes a burning figure, then charcoal, then a pile of ash.

effects.name: Earth Dragon
effects.description: The ground heaves and splits as a huge rock dragon bursts out, weaves through the horde on an S-shaped path throwing enemies into the air, then dives back underground leaving a rift.

effects.name: Chain Storm
effects.description: A bolt strikes the first enemy and leaps to the next, faster with every hop while a counter shows the chain; once it has run through the whole horde every enemy it touched bursts at the same moment.

effects.name: Gravity Maelstrom
effects.description: A gravity vortex opens in the middle of the field and sweeps the horde up into its centre, crushing them into one mass; after a pause it collapses and bursts, scattering the bodies across the ground.

effects.name: Titan Step
effects.description: The sky splits and a stone giant’s foot larger than the frame slowly stamps down, its shadow covering the whole horde; the landing ring throws every enemy around it into the air and flattens those underneath.

effects.name: Phantom Cavalry
effects.description: A ghostly gate opens behind the caster and a line of translucent phantom riders charges across the field, throwing aside every enemy in their path, then dissolves into green mist.

effects.name: Piercing Lance
effects.description: The caster hurls a spear of light that skewers a single-file column of ten, flashing at every body it passes; it can only pierce so many, so anyone beyond the limit survives.

effects.name: Blade Nova
effects.description: Ten enemies surround the caster, who spins on the spot as a ring of wind blades expands from their feet, cutting through the circle and throwing the enemies outwards; anyone beyond the radius is untouched.

effects.name: Seeker Volley
effects.description: A ring of violet bolts appears around the caster; each locks onto one enemy and homes in on its own curved path. The bolts are limited, so when there are more enemies than bolts some survive.

effects.name: Plague Fog
effects.description: The caster lobs a poison seed into the middle of the company; thick green fog rolls out from it and slowly swallows the hundred-strong block, and everyone it engulfs sinks to their knees and withers to bones. Anyone beyond the fog’s radius survives.

effects.name: Sunlens Scorch
effects.description: A huge lens of light appears in the sky and focuses the sun into one white-hot point; the point traces the arc of the enemy line, burning a scorched trail and setting every enemy near its path alight.

effects.name: Thunder Bounce
effects.description: The caster throws a ball of lightning that bounces from squad to squad, bursting into a ring of lightning at every landing that drops the whole squad; it grows with every bounce and the last burst is the biggest. When the bounces run out, the remaining squads survive.

effects.name: Petrifying Eye
effects.description: The clouds part and a giant eye opens above an army of a thousand; its gaze spreads like a widening pool of light and turns the soldiers to stone one by one; when the eye blinks every statue crumbles into rubble at once.

effects.name: Sigil Barrage
effects.description: Rows of dozens of sigils open in the sky and fire bolts downwards row by row from the front, so the explosions roll across the army of a thousand like a carpet; the gaps between the blasts are the only way out.

effects.name: Blood Contagion
effects.description: The caster marks the front soldier with a blood curse that spreads like a contagion to anyone standing close, weaving a red web through the army; then every cursed soldier bursts into crimson light at once. Soldiers standing too far apart for the curse to jump survive.

effects.name: Second Sun
effects.description: A small star ignites above an army of ten thousand and slowly swells into a second sun that lights the ground brighter and brighter; it draws in a breath and lets go, the sky bleaches white, and a heat wave spreads from directly below, vaporising the army ring by ring and leaving scorched earth.

effects.name: Starfall Storm
effects.description: A starry sky draws over the battlefield and thousands of shooting stars streak down at a slant, pelting the army of ten thousand like a downpour; each one blasts a small crater, and they fall thicker and thicker until the whole field is pitted.

effects.name: World Tsunami
effects.description: A wave taller than the frame rises on the horizon and crashes across the field from behind the army, rolling thousands of soldiers forward in its curl; it stops short of the caster and draws back, leaving a soaked battlefield. The wave only travels so far, and anyone beyond its reach survives.

effects.name: Million Host
effects.description: The camera starts on one soldier and pulls back past ten, a hundred, a thousand, ten thousand and a hundred thousand until a million-strong army covers a whole continent. A ring of light comes down around the coast and closes in, turning every soldier it passes into sparks; anyone inside the radius where the ring stops survives.

effects.name: Overkill
effects.description: The caster pulls out their strongest ultimate: the sky changes colour, sigil after sigil unfolds and a pillar of light as wide as a planet charges for ages; only then does the camera find the target, a single small slime. The pillar comes down, the ground splits in two and the counter reads 1/1. Slimes outside the pillar’s radius survive.

effects.name: Downscale
effects.description: The caster snaps and the picture’s resolution halves on every beat; the thousand-strong block merges into bigger and bigger colour blocks until the whole army is a single pixel, which the caster flicks away. Soldiers spread so thin that their block is mostly ground are never merged and survive.

effects.name: Return to Sender
effects.description: Ten thousand archers loose at once, the volley darkens the sky and every arrow flies at the caster, who raises one hand: the arrows stop in mid-air, turn round and fall back along their own arcs onto the archers who shot them. If the caster turns only part of the volley, the rest shatter on a shield and their archers survive.

effects.name: Map Fold
effects.description: The caster grabs the ground and pulls, and the battlefield folds like a sheet of paper along a crease: the half carrying the thousand-strong army swings up and slaps down on the other half, flattening everyone; when the map opens again it bears a mirrored imprint. Soldiers standing right on the crease survive.

effects.name: Domino Pebble
effects.description: The caster flicks a single pebble that knocks over the nearest soldier; he falls into the man beside him and the ten-thousand-strong block goes down like dominoes, row after row, faster and faster. Anyone standing too far from the next man is never touched, and the chain breaks there.

effects.name: Shadow Mutiny
effects.description: The caster makes the sun flare and sink, the shadows of a thousand soldiers stretch across the ground, then stand up one by one as black silhouettes with violet glowing rims and turn their blades on their owners. Soldiers in the shade of the cloud the caster calls in have no shadow and survive.

effects.name: Eraser
effects.description: A giant pixel eraser drops from the sky and scrubs back and forth across the battlefield along the path the caster draws; everything it passes turns into the grey-and-white checkerboard of a paint program’s transparent background, soldiers and ground alike. Soldiers the eraser misses survive.

effects.name: Falling Score
effects.description: The kill counter in the corner starts to shake and its digits break off the screen as giant golden pixel blocks that slam into an army of ten thousand; every wave of kills raises the count, so the next digits are bigger and more numerous, until 10000 lands all at once. Anyone standing in a digit’s hollow, like the middle of a 0, survives.

effects.name: Palette Swap
effects.description: A colour wave sweeps over the thousand red soldiers in a dithered dot pattern; every soldier the pattern picks switches to the caster’s blue and turns on the red comrades beside him. The denser the dither, the more turn; red soldiers with no blue neighbour survive.

effects.name: Sky Fall
effects.description: The caster turns the world upside down: the picture flips, the army of ten thousand loses its footing and falls up into the clouds, and only the soldiers near the glowing anchor stakes the caster drove into the ground hold on. When the picture flips back, everyone beyond the stakes’ reach is gone.

effects.name: Jigsaw
effects.description: Jigsaw seams appear across the battlefield and the pieces under the thousand-strong army flip up one by one and drop into the void below, ground and soldiers together, until only the piece under the caster is left. Soldiers on pieces that are not chosen to fall survive.

effects.name: Twin Coil
effects.description: Two lightning coils wind up a sword along fixed, staggered helix paths, hidden behind the blade and back at its edge; the caster drives the sword into the ground, the coils unwind under the army as a three-armed spiral and then fire along its arms. With fewer arms, soldiers standing between them survive.

effects.name: Drawn Lightning
effects.description: Lightning coils around a scabbard; when the caster draws, the coil straightens into a line and the blade turns out to be the lightning itself, with no steel inside. The drawn blade reaches across the whole battlefield and wipes out every soldier within its width; soldiers outside that width survive.

effects.name: Frost Overgrowth
effects.description: Ice crystals grow up a spear along a helix path and keep going past the tip until the spear is a lance of ice ten times its length; the lance slams into the army, then cracks along the same helix and shatters. Soldiers outside the impact area survive.

effects.name: Siphon
effects.description: A stream of blood is drawn from every soldier within reach, curves through the air to the axe and spirals up its haft; every stream counts as a kill and the axe head brightens a step with the count. Soldiers beyond the reach survive.

effects.name: Rune Projector
effects.description: Three rune rings orbit a greatsword at different heights in opposite directions, then tighten and press into the fuller as cut-outs; sunlight shines through them and projects giant runes onto the battlefield. Soldiers standing in the lit strokes burn; those in the dark between strokes survive.

effects.name: Echo Blade
effects.description: A swordsman makes one cut and eight delayed echoes appear on the same blade path, each repeating it one step further forward; he has already lowered his blade while the kill count keeps climbing. Soldiers outside every echo’s arc survive.

effects.name: Traced Halo
effects.description: A point of light traces a sword’s outline, then fills it from hilt to tip, cooling from white to steel; eight swords are traced in turn and orbit the caster, hidden by the body as they pass behind. They fire one by one at the nearest enemies and are traced again along the same outlines. Soldiers no sword picks survive.

effects.name: Land Blade
effects.description: A point of light traces the outline of a giant sword on the ground around the army; the ground inside lifts out in one piece, a sword cut from the battlefield itself with the army standing on it. The caster swings it and stops it dead, flinging every soldier on the blade; soldiers outside the outline stay on the ground and survive.

effects.name: Thousand into One
effects.description: Every sword within reach is pulled out of the soldiers’ hands and spirals up on staggered paths into the slots of one giant sword; once it is full, the giant sword falls on the army. Soldiers outside its impact area are only disarmed and survive.

effects.name: Anvil Field
effects.description: A mould appears in the sky and molten iron runs into it along guide lines; on every beat an invisible giant hammer comes down on the army below while the iron cools step by step from white to orange, red and steel: the army is the anvil. After three blows the weapon is forged. Soldiers outside the hammer faces survive.

effects.name: Needle Thread
effects.description: The summon is just one needle. It flies a pre-computed route through every soldier in turn, trailing a glowing thread that passes in front of and behind each of them; the caster pulls and the whole army is cinched into one bundle. Soldiers past the end of the thread are never threaded and survive.

effects.name: Endless Blade
effects.description: A small portal opens in front of the caster and a hilt slides out, then the blade keeps coming, and coming, across the whole battlefield; the portal plane cuts the blade, so the part still inside is never seen. Once it is out it sweeps a fan about the portal, striking down every soldier inside the fan; those outside survive.
